method: Published quantities -> learner-entered blank unit relationships -> prior accepted learner values only.
invariants: Area, volume and linear units stay in separate dimension families.
Original 20 square metres and 8 cubic metres quantity bounds retained.
Original pure conversion forms retained, plus same-unit addition/subtraction then conversion.
No computed values prefilled or main-answer transfer.
Direct creation and normal generation share the same guide.
Obsolete drafts reset; new partial drafts restore.
samples: All fourteen measurement units: 1200 generated samples and at least 100 distinct public prompts per unit; new area and volume direct-creation samples independently checked against unit sizes and source bounds. Distinct prompts do not mean distinct answers or numeric facts.
limits: Tests and normal-UI evidence are different layers.
No assertion of all-country curricula, physical devices, learner comprehension or release readiness.
